description: Calculates the electric field strength produced by a point charge at a given distance using Coulomb's law: E = kQ/r². Uses permittivity parameter or defaults to vacuum permittivity. (cost: 1 credit)

charge.description: number, required, electric charge in coulombs (C)

distance.description: number, required, distance from the charge in meters (m)

permitivity.description: number, optional, permittivity of the medium in F/m, default 8.854e-12 (vacuum)

name: calculate_electric_field
